visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up view of yellow noodles being lifted from a steaming bowl of red-tinted spicy soup using black chopsticks. The scene captures the texture of the noodles and minced meat toppings against a blurred restaurant background. The lighting is bright and focuses on the food's glossy surface. (2) A female staff member wearing a black cap, black face mask, and black gloves presents a large white bowl of ramen to the camera. The setting is a professional kitchen counter area with stainless steel equipment and stacks of bowls visible in the background. (3) A sequence showing the preparation of the ramen: creamy white broth is poured into a bowl with a spicy base, and a metal whisk is used to mix the ingredients. The camera focuses on the liquid's movement and consistency. (4) Fresh yellow noodles are strained in a metal basket over boiling water and then placed into a bowl of orange-colored spicy soup. The action is rhythmic and emphasizes the speed of the professional kitchen environment. (5) A handheld butane torch is used to char two thick slices of pork belly (chashu) on a wire rack. Blue and orange flames flicker across the meat, creating a caramelized brown surface. (6) Various toppings are added with metal tongs: thick bamboo shoots, a scoop of seasoned minced meat, and drizzles of red chili oil and flakes. The camera uses tight close-ups to highlight the individual ingredients. (7) A second bowl of ramen is introduced, featuring a pale, creamy chicken broth topped with sliced white meat, chopped red and green onions, and a sheet of seaweed. The lighting remains warm and focused. (8) Shots of side dishes including a bowl of chashu rice topped with diced meat and green onions, followed by a piece of golden-brown fried pork chop being held up to show its juicy interior. (9) A view of the restaurant interior with wooden tables, slatted walls, and customers sitting at a service bar. Text overlays provide address information while the camera pans across the dining area. (10) The final exterior shot of the restaurant '清流房' showing its wooden storefront and Japanese-style signage with a bowl icon.
